body: Hand-over from P4-24 (Data saver switch, drawn 14 Nov 2026): three of the four planned effects of the switch are P4-24's (stream and new-download quality, small pictures, only the next song prepared). The fourth, "syncing less on mobile data", stays with this item and is NOT behind any switch: it is always on. The acceptance clause that P4-24's task text used to carry ("the idle sync on mobile data moves less than before", measured with the phone's own per-app data counter, switch on or not) is now this item's to add to its acceptance, next to the B-81 clause ("a navigation is never a trigger on mobile data"). P4-24's task text no longer claims it.
